feature: Attraction services with multiple ticket types

implementation.relationship: Vendor -> Facility -> Service -> embedded ticket_types with individual ObjectIds
implementation.service_base_price: Derived minimum for existing search/legacy API compatibility; registration sends ticket_types rather than a single service price
implementation.simple_purchase_flow: Vendor saves ticket types; active facility exposes them immediately; customer ticks ticket types, enters quantities and submits a PENDING purchase request. Inventory schedules are optional for new types.
implementation.inventory_price: Current ticket price when uses_ticket_price=true; explicit date price otherwise
implementation.payment: Paused by user: no payment endpoint, no Payment created, no QR issued for new requests, no automatic paid status

backend_tests.note: Optional isolated MongoDB integration suite was not run after user requested using the existing database only

verification.migration_in_test_database: Previously tested before scope reduction; not run or required for the current simple flow
verification.mongo_readback: Confirmed real PENDING booking, 2 adult tickets at 150000 and 1 child ticket at 80000, linked service/type IDs and no Payment

shared_database_migration.status: Not needed for simple direct ticket selection; no bulk migration executed
shared_database_migration.automatic_review: Rejected writing to the shared configured MongoDB and changing inventory index without explicit authorization
shared_database_migration.legacy_policy: Adds one ticket type from each existing service name/base_price; preserves existing daily prices and snapshots; does not delete records or duplicate services; historical fields never recorded cannot be reconstructed
